name: AMI Meeting Corpus
description: The AMI Meeting Corpus is a multi-modal dataset consisting of 100 hours of meeting recordings captured in specialized instrumented meeting rooms. It includes synchronized multi-channel audio, multi-angle video, slides, whiteboard notes, and rich linguistic and behavioral annotations (dialog acts, topic segmentation, head gestures).
